# Permafile

The slow-changing truth about me. An AI reads this before anything else.

## Who I am
- Year / program: final year, psychology, writing an honours thesis
- How my ADHD shows up: time blindness, and starting is the hard part, not finishing
- When I work best: mornings before lunch, phone in the other room

## This season
- What this term is about: get the thesis draft in by mid November
- What a good week looks like: three deep blocks on the thesis, the small stuff done on time

## Standing commitments
- Lab meeting Wednesdays at 2
- Piano lesson Saturdays

## Rules for me
- Three fronts at most. Let go rather than carry.
- Every active item has a physical first step.

## Rules for the AI
- No guilt, no lectures. Plain and kind.
- Suggest at most three actions, each with a physical first step.
- Ask before assuming something is dropped.
